tldr: Tech stocks surged following strong earnings from Nvidia and Salesforce, driven by increased demand for AI technologies and cybersecurity tools.
Nepal has been hit by catastrophic flash floods and landslides near the Tibet border, resulting in hundreds dead or missing and warnings of further danger from rising lake water.
US President Trump signed an executive order to rename Lake Ontario as "Lake America," a move that coincides with ongoing trade tensions and increased tariffs between the US and Canada.

market.why: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite closed higher, driven by strong earnings reports and optimistic forecasts from major tech companies. Nvidia's blowout earnings boosted confidence in AI demand, while Salesforce reported a strong quarter and an expanded AI partnership. Cybersecurity firms like CrowdStrike and Okta also saw their stocks rise due to increased customer spending on security tools.

yield_10y.why: The 10-year Treasury yield saw a slight increase. This occurred as the market anticipated remarks from Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh at the annual Jackson Hole Symposium, with prediction markets indicating a low probability of him mentioning a rate cut.

vix.why: The VIX decreased, indicating a reduction in market volatility. This can be attributed to the positive corporate earnings and a generally bullish sentiment in the stock market, including increased investment from family offices.

mortgage.why: The 30-year fixed mortgage rate, as reported in the weekly Freddie Mac survey, increased slightly. This movement tracks the recent direction of the 10-year Treasury yield, which also saw a minor increase.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A Utah bill modifies provisions related to the property tax exemption process.
policy_upcoming.effect: Once you own a home, you will have deadlines for filing an application for a property tax exemption with the county board of equalization and for the board to render a decision.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A bill amends requirements for health insurance preauthorization in Utah.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your health insurer must make an authorization or adverse preauthorization determination within a defined maximum time.

policy_week.what_happened: Proposed regulations would provide guidance on employer contributions to Trump accounts and related nondiscrimination rules.
policy_week.effect: Your employer's contributions to your Trump account would be subject to new guidance.

policy_calendar.label: Utah Truth in Taxation hearings — expected during August
policy_calendar.note: A Utah taxing entity that wants more property tax revenue than the certified rate allows must hold a public hearing, and those hearings are held in August. The county's Notice of Property Valuation and Tax Changes, mailed in July, carries the actual date and place for a given parcel.

tech.summary: Nvidia is reportedly acquiring Hugging Face, an AI model repository, for $13 billion, consolidating its infrastructure for open AI models amidst growing industry interest.

Google's AI note-taking application, Gemini Notebook, now includes an "Expert Intelligence" feature that allows users to integrate content from their Google Play Books, enabling AI-driven questions, content generation, and infographics based on purchased titles.

Speedo has introduced a new removable smart module for its Vanquisher goggles, part of the Speedo iQ system, which can analyze a swimmer's performance across all four competitive strokes by tracking head movement, breath timing, and distance per stroke.

world.summary: Catastrophic flash floods and landslides near the Nepal-Tibet border have resulted in nearly 400 deaths and almost 1,400 missing, predominantly tourists, with authorities warning of fresh dangers from rising lake water.

US President Donald Trump signed an executive order to rename Lake Ontario as "Lake America," a decision made as the US and Canada are engaged in a trade dispute following increased tariffs, which some reports suggest could jeopardize nearly 90,000 Canadian jobs.

Indonesia is grappling with widespread wildfires, particularly in West Kalimantan, where smoke and ash are severely impacting residents' health, with pregnant women and children identified as particularly vulnerable.
An Israeli strike in southern Lebanon resulted in the death of a newlywed woman and injuries to several other individuals in Nabatieh.

us.summary: The US Postal Service announced that new restrictions on mail-in ballots are now in effect, following a US Supreme Court ruling that supported changes backed by President Donald Trump, although new legal challenges have been initiated.
A Florida grand jury concluded that the administration of Governor DeSantis misappropriated funds from a Medicaid settlement for political activities, though no indictments were issued.
Illinois has implemented a new law that establishes regulations for the use of electric bikes and scooters within the state.

science.summary: US health officials have approved a landmark pancreatic cancer drug that offers a new treatment approach by blocking a protein responsible for tumor growth, shown to improve survival in the majority of cases.

A comprehensive review of 80 major trials involving nearly 30,000 people found that nicotine vapes are the most effective method for quitting smoking, increasing the success rate by approximately 60 percent compared to traditional aids.
